story.title: A warm welcome in the heart of Gunungsitoli.
story.body: Hotel Soliga is located on Jalan Pangeran Diponegoro in Gunungsitoli. Explore the available rooms and contact our team about your stay.

items.question: Where is Hotel Soliga located?
items.answer: Hotel Soliga is at Jalan Pangeran Diponegoro No. 432, Gunungsitoli, Nias Island, North Sumatra.

items.question: How can I ask about room availability?
items.answer: Choose your dates and room type in the reservation form. Your request details will open in WhatsApp so you can send them to the hotel team.

items.question: How can I contact Hotel Soliga?
items.answer: Contact the team by WhatsApp or phone. Contact details are at the bottom of this page.
